note: Descriptor codes are ACARA Australian Curriculum v9 codes, confirmed against the official curriculum workbook (see spec-sources.md). Descriptions are our own paraphrases. Generator ranges are our intended difficulty per year, not ACARA's.

3.label: Year 3
3.reading_level: simple sentences of about 8 to 12 words, everyday vocabulary; introduce any subject word in the question itself

4.label: Year 4
4.reading_level: short sentences of about 10 to 15 words, familiar vocabulary; subject words from the year's topics are fine

5.label: Year 5
5.reading_level: sentences up to about 20 words, wider vocabulary; multi-step questions are fine if the steps are clear
